definitions.explanation: The combined systems that supply clean water to and drain wastewater from a building or facility.

examples.japanese: {給排水|きゅうはいすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Carry out water-supply and drainage work.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給排水|きゅうはいすい}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Inspect the plumbing of the apartment building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{給排水|きゅうはいすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配管|はいかん}→配管：07495_haikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In old buildings, the water-supply and drainage pipes are often deteriorated.

notes:
A combined term blending ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧ (water supply) + ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧ (drainage). Common in construction, real estate, and building maintenance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給排水|きゅうはいすい}⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧: water-supply and drainage equipment; plumbing
- {給排水|きゅうはいすい}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: plumbing work
- {給排水|きゅうはいすい}⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧: water-supply and drainage pipes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給水|きゅうすい}→給水：15031_kyuusui⟧: water supply — only the incoming-water half
- ⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧: drainage — only the wastewater half
